ruleOfThumb: Community public libraries only — not research-only special collections, not bookstores, not random websites.
Never trust a pasted link alone: deny scam/shortener hosts; require https; require community-library signals (name/host).
BiblioCommons catalogs: live-probe, then auto-admit with borrowable yes/no checks (system scope).
Other community catalogs/homepages: auto-admit as open-catalog places (favorite + open to search) — not stuck pending just for a different vendor.
Pending only when name-only or not clearly a community library — owner notified either way for auto-adds.
Scam / shortener / phishing / adult store fronts → hard reject (no pending).
Halalit is not the library — availability is a helper, not a checkout system.
